description: This file defines an abstract base class for command responses related to 'CommonCommand's within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides common functionality and constants used by subclasses, including handling response type, HTTP status code, headers, and resource identification.

classes.name: CommonCommandResponse
classes.description: An abstract class representing a generic response to CommonCommand objects, providing common properties like response type, HTTP status, headers, and resource type.

methods.name: CommonCommandResponse
methods.description: Constructor initializing response type, status code, and headers for the command response.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer indicating the resource path associated with this response.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the string 'common', indicating the resource type of this response.
